statement_summary: Sanctions, including for misuse of customer device data
Vendor review and contract terms before customer data is shared
Retention of security documentation and no-notice determinations
Unique named accounts in SYS-01, bench PCs, and manufacturer portals
Role-based SYS-01 access; passcodes visible only to the assigned technician
MFA for all sensitive access
Same-day access removal at termination
Unique local admin passwords; change default passwords
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; anonymous line
Preserve evidence; do not reimage devices under investigation
Meet legal and contractual notice deadlines
regulatory_driver: N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(3); (4)); N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 12.10.1); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)

statement_summary: Annual incident response test
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Never collect account passwords; passcodes only in the restricted field, purged at release
Customer data access standard for technicians
Card data only in P2PE terminals; terminal list and weekly inspections
Delete recovered data 30 days after delivery
SP 800-88 Rev. 2 sanitization with a certificate per device; shred background reports
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Annual training, reminders, phishing exercises, and terminal tampering training
Approved generative AI tools only; no customer data in unapproved tools
